## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-3 is not independently inspectable: the supplied stdout truncates before the selected 37-row order, minor entries, and determinant field, and no \(F_2\) minor is displayed.
- claim-4 is likewise unauditable for both families because the complete retained reduction vectors are unavailable. Exact comparisons \(P(k,\mu)=L((k),\mu)\) are not exhibited.
- claim-5 is described as a Smith conclusion, but the script implements determinant/inverse reduction rather than an independent Smith-normal-form computation.
- The quotient identification remains conditional on the integral box/Schur-span presentation; the finite computation alone does not establish that hypothesis.

## Unresolved certificates
- [computation] Export a complete, digest-checked certificate for both \(F_1\) and \(F_2\): fixed column and selected-row orders, the two \(37\times37\) complementary matrices with exact determinants \(\pm1\), and every integral Pieri and LR reduction vector.
- [computation] Independently generate the LR relation matrix, verify every \(P(k,\mu)=L((k),\mu)\), and compute Smith invariants \(1^{37},0^3\) using a separately implemented exact SNF routine.
